boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Massachusetts-Amherst
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-evening destinations on campus and in downtown Amherst, selected for food, coffee, or a late study stop without 21+-only access.

cards.title: Worcester Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: 667 N Pleasant St, UMass Amherst
cards.notes: Use the Northeast dining commons when you need a campus meal later in the evening; check the dining site for holiday and special-event changes.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining with a documented nightly midnight close.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Dining lists Worcester Commons regular hours as 7:00 AM–midnight daily and Late Night as 9:00 PM–midnight Sunday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours listed: 7:00 AM–midnight daily; Late Night is listed 9:00 PM–midnight Sunday–Saturday. Hours may vary for holidays and special events.

cards.title: Berkshire Dining Commons
cards.subtitle: 121 Southwest Cir, UMass Amherst
cards.notes: Head to Southwest for a late dining-commons stop, and confirm the current menu or calendar before walking over during breaks.
cards.short_summary: A Southwest dining stop documented through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Dining lists Berkshire Dining Commons regular hours as 11:00 AM–midnight daily, with Late Night from 9:00 PM–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Regular hours listed: 11:00 AM–midnight daily; Late Night is listed 9:00 PM–midnight. The page notes summer closure and schedules can change.

cards.title: UMass Amherst Campus Center
cards.subtitle: 1 Campus Center Way, UMass Amherst
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as an on-campus late stop or meeting point, and verify which individual dining counters are operating that day.
cards.short_summary: The Campus Center itself is listed open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Dining lists Campus Center regular hours as 7:00 AM–12:00 AM daily.
cards.access_notes: Campus Center hours are listed as 7:00 AM–12:00 AM daily; individual dining locations have separate hours.

cards.entity_name: W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.title: W. E. B. Du Bois Library
cards.subtitle: 154 Hicks Way, UMass Amherst
cards.notes: Bring your work to the library’s documented quiet and group study areas; check the live library-hours calendar before an evening visit.
cards.short_summary: A late study destination with quiet and group spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UMass Libraries identifies the Du Bois Library as offering quiet and group study spaces; its current hours calendar lists closing at 11:00 PM on Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Current library calendar lists 11:00 PM closing on Monday–Thursday and Sunday; confirm term, holiday, and access details before going.

cards.title: Campus Pizza
cards.subtitle: 150 Fearing St, across from Southwest Towers
cards.notes: For a late Thursday-through-Saturday food run near Southwest, use the restaurant’s online ordering or call ahead before heading across Fearing Street.
cards.short_summary: A pizza and calzone counter across from Southwest with 2 AM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Pizza states it is open Thursday–Saturday from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM and is located across from Southwest Towers.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Thursday–Saturday 5:00 PM–2:00 AM; Sunday 4:00–9:00 PM and Wednesday 5:00–10:00 PM. Closed Monday–Tuesday.

cards.title: Antonio's Pizza Amherst
cards.subtitle: 31 North Pleasant St, downtown Amherst
cards.notes: Pick up a slice or whole pie downtown on Friday or Saturday; use the restaurant’s ordering page to confirm the current close time.
cards.short_summary: Downtown pizza by the slice with a documented 1 AM weekend close.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonio’s official Amherst page states that the shop stays open until 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists Friday and Saturday hours through 1:00 AM; it lists 10:00 PM closes Monday–Thursday and Sunday.

cards.title: Royal Chicken & Kebab
cards.subtitle: 1 Boltwood Walk, downtown Amherst
cards.notes: Use this downtown counter for a late pickup or delivery order; verify the day’s hours on the restaurant site before departing campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown chicken, kebab, and sandwich stop listed through 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Royal Chicken & Kebab lists hours of 10:00 AM–midnight Monday–Wednesday and 10:00 AM–2:00 AM Thursday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists closing at midnight Monday–Wednesday and 2:00 AM Thursday–Sunday; it also offers pickup, delivery, and dine-in.

cards.title: D.P. Dough Amherst
cards.subtitle: 18 North Pleasant St, downtown Amherst
cards.notes: For a later downtown calzone pickup, confirm the Amherst store’s open status and order route before walking or arranging delivery.
cards.short_summary: A calzone-focused Amherst location with late-night service listed on its official ordering presence.
cards.evidence_claim: D.P. Dough’s Amherst location is listed on the company’s official online ordering system with evening hours extending to 1:00 AM on weekdays and 2:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering availability should be checked for the Amherst location before travel; posted late hours can change by day or service mode.

cards.title: Protocol
cards.subtitle: North Pleasant Street, downtown Amherst
cards.notes: Plan this as a Friday or Saturday dinner stop and reserve or check the restaurant’s updates if you are arriving close to the listed close.
cards.short_summary: A downtown restaurant with documented midnight dinner service on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Protocol’s official FAQ lists dinner hours of 4:00 PM–midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official FAQ lists dinner until 12:00 AM Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday dinner is listed until 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Amherst Coffee
cards.subtitle: 28 Amity St, downtown Amherst
cards.notes: Use the café service for a late coffee or baked treat Tuesday through Saturday, and confirm the café counter remains available before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A downtown coffee stop whose café hours run to midnight most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Amherst Coffee lists café hours of 7:00 AM–midnight Tuesday–Saturday and identifies coffee, espresso, teas, and baked treats.
cards.access_notes: Official café hours are Tuesday–Saturday 7:00 AM–12:00 AM; Monday closes at 5:00 PM and Sunday at 3:00 PM. This card concerns café service, not the bar.

warnings: Hours are subject to holidays, academic breaks, special events, and service changes; check each direct source before making a late-night trip.
